---
title: "Idea stress test"
description: "Describe a business idea; get its business model, the three claims most likely to kill it, a hostile second opinion and a citation check. Backtested on 52 companies whose outcomes are known, including where it fails."
body-classes: wide
---

```{=html}

    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); }
  .st-form textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 4.2rem; }
  .st-form input:focus, .st-form textarea:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: var(--accent); }
  .st-count { font: 400 12px "Geist Mono", monospace; color: var(--muted); float: right; }
  .st-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: .5rem 0 .25rem; }
  .st-actions button { padding: 9px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); font-weight: 500; }

  .st-actions button.ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); }
```

::: {.st-lede}
Describe a business idea. You get its business model, the three claims it depends on that are most likely to be false (each with a test under $500), a hostile second opinion from a different model, and a check of every source it cites. It never gives a score: no tool can pick winners, and this one doesn't pretend to.
:::


::: {.st-facts}
::: {}
[How good is it?]{.k}

[BACKTEST_ONE_LINER]{#st-backtest}  [Method and results →](method/)
:::
::: {}
[What you get]{.k}

Business model (value metric against the buyer's alternative, channel, unit economics as ranges, incumbents' economics, moat copyability, capital), the compeller and how failure to act gets detected, three kill-shots, objections, and a verified-citation rate.
:::
::: {}
[What it costs]{.k}

One free report per 30 days per connection, then $4 per report. A report takes about three minutes and costs me roughly $0.07 in model and search fees.
:::
:::

```{=html}
<script src="https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js?render=explicit" async defer></script>
<script>
(() => {
  const API = location.hostname === "localhost" || location.hostname === "127.0.0.1" ? "http://localhost:8790" : "https://tools.wknipe.com";
  const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
  const esc = (s) => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({"&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;"}[c]));
  const form = $("#st-form"), out = $("#st-out"), go = $("#st-go"), quota = $("#st-quota");
  const FIELDS = ["product", "customer", "industry", "geography", "price_idea", "stage", "anything_else"];
  const EX = [
    {product: "A web app that drafts the GDPR record of processing and DPIA documents for small clinics from a 20-minute questionnaire, and keeps them current.", customer: "Practice managers at private dental and physio clinics with 3–30 staff; the owner pays.", industry: "Healthcare compliance software", geography: "Denmark, then the Nordics", price_idea: "DKK 300 / month", stage: "Idea", anything_else: "The data protection authority has started spot checks of small health practices."},
    {product: "Groceries delivered in 15 minutes from dark stores, ordered in an app.", customer: "Busy urban professionals; they pay per order.", industry: "Quick commerce", geography: "New York City", price_idea: "Supermarket prices plus a $1.99 delivery fee", stage: "Raised a seed round, 2 dark stores", anything_else: "Couriers on e-bikes; no minimum basket."},
  ];
  let widget = null, q = null;
  const msg = (html, err) => { out.innerHTML = `<div class="st-msg ${err ? "err" : ""}">${html}</div>`; };
  for (const el of document.querySelectorAll(".st-count")) {
    const f = document.getElementById(el.dataset.for);
    const upd = () => { el.textContent = `${f.value.length} / ${f.maxLength}`; };
    f.addEventListener("input", upd); upd();
  }
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-ex]").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const ex = EX[+b.dataset.ex]; for (const k of FIELDS) form.elements[k].value = ex[k] || ""; form.querySelectorAll("textarea,input").forEach((e) => e.dispatchEvent(new Event("input")));
  }));
  if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("cancelled")) msg("Payment cancelled; nothing was charged.");

  fetch(`${API}/api/quota`, {credentials: "omit"}).then((r) => r.json()).then((d) => {
    q = d;
    quota.textContent = d.killed ? "Switched off for now." : d.allPaused ? "This month's budget is used up; it reopens on the 1st." :
      d.freeAvailable ? "Your first report is free." : d.freePaused ? `Today's free reports are used up; a report is $${d.price_usd}.` : `You've used your free report; a report is $${d.price_usd}.`;
    const mount = () => window.turnstile ? (widget = window.turnstile.render("#st-turnstile", {sitekey: d.sitekey, theme: "auto", size: "flexible"})) : setTimeout(mount, 200);
    mount();
  }).catch(() => { quota.textContent = "The service is unreachable right now."; });

  async function pay(sid) {
    const r = await fetch(`${API}/api/checkout`, {method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify({submission_id: sid})});
    const d = await r.json();
    if (d.url) location.href = d.url; else msg(esc(d.error || "Checkout failed."), true);
  }

  form.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const input = Object.fromEntries(FIELDS.map((k) => [k, form.elements[k].value.trim()]));
    const missing = ["product", "customer", "industry", "geography"].filter((k) => !input[k]);
    if (missing.length) return msg(`Please fill in: ${missing.map((k) => k.replace("_", " ")).join(", ")}.`, true);
    const token = widget !== null && window.turnstile ? window.turnstile.getResponse(widget) : "";
    if (!token) return msg("Please complete the human check above the button.", true);
    go.disabled = true; msg("Submitting…");
    try {
      const r = await fetch(`${API}/api/submit`, {method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify({input, turnstile: token})});
      const d = await r.json();
      if (d.report_id) { location.href = `report/?id=${encodeURIComponent(d.report_id)}`; return; }
      if (r.status === 402) {
        out.innerHTML = `<div class="st-msg">${esc(d.reason)} This report is $${esc(d.price_usd)}, paid by card through Stripe; it starts the moment payment clears.
          <div class="st-actions" style="margin-top:.75rem">${d.payments_enabled ? `<button type="button" id="st-pay">Pay $${esc(d.price_usd)} and run</button>` : "<span>Paid reports open soon.</span>"}</div></div>`;
        const b = document.getElementById("st-pay"); if (b) b.addEventListener("click", () => { b.disabled = true; pay(d.submission_id); });
      } else msg(esc(d.error || `Error ${r.status}`), true);
    } catch { msg("The service is unreachable right now.", true); }
    go.disabled = false; if (window.turnstile && widget !== null) window.turnstile.reset(widget);
  });
})();
</script>
```
